title: Allah Tera Hussain
body:
Allah (5)……la elaha illallah….mohammadur rasullullah…illaha bad par seena hussain hai (2)      hussain (14)
sattar kadam se zainab deti rahi sadaa
bhai tera hai tanha ab dekhle Khuda
zehra ka  laadla hai ….allah ye karbala hai ,teri raza ki khaatir sar ko kataa raha hai
allah tera hussain (4) hussain (14)
dare khaima se dekhti hu mai bhi ran ….ay mere allah
mujhe hussain kyu aata nahi nazar………ay mere allah
dekha manzar to phat gaya mera jigar…ay mere allah
teer sine pe apne kha raha hai………….tera hussain
sar ko sajde me ab jhuka raha hai……..tera hussain
shukr sajde me bajaa la raha hai………..tera hussain
teri tauheed ko bacha raha hai
allah tera hussain (4) hussain (14)
jule se gir raha tha asgar ko barida
hurmul ke teer ka mai se seh luga haskera
asgar che maah ka hai ……. allah ye karbala hai ,teri raza ki khaatir sar ko kataa raha hai
allah tera hussain (4) hussain (14)
ali asgar pe chal teer Al aman ……………ay mere allah
khoon se tar tha gal khush tar zabaan…….ay mere allah
aisa maasoom pyaasa aj tak kaha…………..ay mere allah
uski choti kabar banaa chuka hai……………tera hussain
baap ka karz bhi nibha chuka hai……………tera hussain
lahu chehre pe uske mal chuka hai……….tera hussain
haaye halmin ki sadaa de chuka hai
allah tera hussain (4) hussain (14)
jung ka bhi nibhana abbas bawafa ko
paaband kar rah atha karbak ke murtaza ko
sakkae sakina hai allah ye karbala hai ,teri raza ki khaatir sar ko kataa raha hai
allah tera hussain (4) hussain (14)
baazu tan pe nahi the gaazi jab gira………………ay mereallah
nahi pyaaso ka pahocha khaime aasra …………ay mere allah
reh gaye pyaase bacche paani na mila…………..ay mere allah
chota baccho ko de raha hai dilaase……………tera hussin
dekh nahi sakta bacho ko pyaase……………….tera hussain
raha kehta hai ye hare k roti maa se……..…..tera hussain
raha pyaasa par na daraa kazaa se
allah tera hussain (4) hussain (14)
akbar jawaa ka laasha maktal me hai sambhaala
sine se neza isne akbar ke hai nikala
aalin kahi figa hai allah ye karbala hai ,teri raza ki khaatir sar ko jhukaa raha hai
allah tera hussain (4) hussain (14)
ham shakle Mustafa maktal me hai tadpa …………….ay mere allah
kaasim ke tukde hai maktal me jaa basaa………………ay mere allah
laaye dono ke laashe iska tha hausla………………………ay mere allah
laash akbar ko utha gir ke utha…………….tera hussain
chaar su fauj me aan gira……………………..tera hussain
jo har Mustafa nabiyo ki bapaa ………..…tera hussain
sham jana hai mujhe keh ye gaya
allah tera hussain (6)
